description.value: Big Way Hot Pot is a growing BC-based hot pot chain offering a self-serve individual hot pot format with over 100 fresh ingredients and more than 18 broths and dry mixes. The Richmond location is part of a network spanning multiple Lower Mainland cities. Diners choose their broth — including a vegan tomato option — and cook premium meats, seafood, and vegetables tableside.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Big Way Hot Pot is a real, actively operating chain with a Richmond location listed in its navigation (both 'Richmond' and 'Richmond Ackroyd' appear as active BC locations). The menu page confirms vegan options are available ('Tomato Broth - *Vegan Option Available*') and the product page references app-based ordering ('Order via app / Order today from wherever you want'), supporting a takeout value. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: The website contact page lists '2633 Viking Wy #208, Richmond, BC V6V 3B7' as its address, which appears to be the corporate head office rather than the 4940 Number 3 Road restaurant location in OSM — the OSM restaurant address could not be confirmed from website content.

The website contains unfilled template placeholder content (contact@sushi.com emails, generic (414) area code phone numbers, nonsensical US addresses) suggesting the site template was not fully cleaned up — contact details from the website's location blocks are unreliable.
No phone number is available for the Richmond location specifically in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating restaurant chain with a confirmed Richmond location. A practical dining stop for touring cyclists seeking a substantial hot pot meal with vegan options.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists Tomato Broth with '(Vegan Option Available)' noted explicitly
